examples.name: Valley
examples.description: A souls-like on a 2 km mountain valley with a day and night cycle: stamina combat, rolls, lock-on, bonfires and Estus, on landscape layers for ground, rock, snow, forest floor and trails, meadow grass, pine and spruce forest and bushes made with the Foliage Creator, a torch-lit hamlet with breakable barrels, and a skull cave down into a three-level dungeon with a boss in its throne arena.
